contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Get in touch if you find an incorrect price, a broken link, or an error in the catalogue.
contact.emailUnavailable: A public contact address will be added before the site launches.
contact.detailsDescription: Include the shoe name, retailer, and page address. This will help us find the relevant record.
contact.ordersDescription: ShoeFinder doesn't sell shoes or process orders. Contact the retailer about an order, delivery, or return.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This initial policy describes the data ShoeFinder processes while it is a prototype.
privacy.prototypeNotice: Before public launch, this policy must be completed with the service operator's legal details and a reviewed data-retention period.
privacy.languageData: Language preference. Your selected language is stored in a cookie for up to one year.
privacy.clickData: Retailer-link clicks. When you open a retailer offer, we record the offer, selected language, referring ShoeFinder page, and click time. The click record doesn't store an IP address or browser identifier.
privacy.technicalData: Technical logs. The server may temporarily process an IP address and request details to operate and secure the site.
privacy.messageData: Contact details. If you send an email, its contents and sender information are used to respond.
privacy.redirectPurpose: To open the retailer offer you selected.
privacy.securityPurpose: To operate and secure the site.
privacy.sharingDescription: Opening a retailer link takes you to that retailer's site. The retailer processes data under its own privacy policy. Hosting and infrastructure providers may process technical data to operate the site.
privacy.retentionDescription: The language cookie lasts for up to one year. The prototype doesn't yet delete click records automatically. A specific retention period must be set before public launch.
privacy.choicesDescription: You can remove the language cookie through your browser settings. ShoeFinder doesn't currently use user accounts, newsletters, or advertising cookies.

affiliate.title: Affiliate disclosure
affiliate.intro: ShoeFinder compares retailer offers. It isn't an online store and doesn't sell shoes.
affiliate.linksDescription: Some retailer links may be affiliate links. If you open a link and make a purchase, ShoeFinder may receive a commission. This doesn't increase the price you pay.
affiliate.orderDescription: An affiliate relationship doesn't change the price or availability reported by a retailer. Product-page offers are ordered by currency, availability, price freshness, and item price. Commission rates don't affect the order.
affiliate.accuracyDescription: Prices, sizes, delivery, and availability may change after the last check. Confirm the final price and terms on the retailer's site before buying.
affiliate.retailerDescription: Your purchase contract is with the retailer. The retailer is responsible for payment, delivery, returns, and customer support.
